info.description: Flow-oriented Postman collection for repeatable integration scenarios. Use these requests in order to exercise a complete user journey against the local backend.

item.name: Identity onboarding happy path
item.description: Bootstrap an admin, create an invitation, and redeem it for a new member.

item.name: Post-bootstrap invitation follow-up
item.description: Run after bootstrap is complete to create and revoke a second invitation using the bootstrapped admin identity.

item.name: Session lifecycle and authenticated messaging
item.description: Log in, call protected messaging endpoints, log out, and verify the revoked session is rejected.

item.name: Run-all API smoke journey
item.description: Single ordered workflow that covers onboarding, invitations, sessions, protected messaging, an administrator revoking a member's sessions, post-revocation authorization behavior, and admin logout.
